All LTHSC clients, regardless of their serostatus, were ask to participate and to fill a short questionnaire and to give a finger prick blood sample for antibody studies.
An voluntary, anonymous sentinel seroprevalence (antibody status) surveillance linked to anonymous risk-behavior questionnaires in low treshold health service centres (needle exchange). Questionnaires and finger prick blood samples were connected with a barcode.
